description: Reads the AI Visibility Index by AIGROW: for a kind of business and a city or country, which businesses ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok name when buyers ask for a recommendation, with each one's share of the answers, the edition and the link to the Index page. Covers 44 categories (local trades such as dentists and plumbers by city, software such as CRM by country) across 88 cities and 20 countries. Category and place may be written in any of the eleven supported languages.

category.description: The kind of business, for example "dentist", "Zahnarzt" or "crm".

language.description: The language to answer in, as an ISO 639-1 code: en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, pl, sv, da or no. Any other code answers in English.

place.description: A city or a country, for example "Berlin", "Milano" or "Germany".

name: ai_index_lookup
title: AI Visibility Index lookup
